# Pretendard 1.3.9

Unmodified Pretendard Variable WOFF2 font by Kil Hyung-jin, distributed under SIL Open Font License 1.1 (see LICENSE).

Source: https://github.com/orioncactus/pretendard/tree/v1.3.9/packages/pretendard/dist/web/variable

The collaboration panel serves the pinned font locally so its Korean typography remains consistent when external font CDNs are unavailable or the app is offline.
